#### 1. Joubert syndrome with renal defect  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.453)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-5620912)

Loss-of-function mutations in NPHP1 disrupt the ciliogenesis and planar cell polarity pathway, leading to both renal abnormalities characteristic of Meckel syndrome type 3 and Joubert syndrome with renal defect, and neuronal developmental abnormalities characteristic of Joubert syndrome.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of individuals with pathogenic variants in NPHP1 who exhibit neither renal nor neuronal developmental abnormalities would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: rs143466771)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of NPHP1 in ciliogenesis and planar cell polarity provides a common therapeutic target for both Meckel syndrome type 3 and Joubert syndrome with renal defect, potentially leading to interventions that address the underlying pathway dysfunction and mitigate both renal and neurological phenotypes.
